description: This PHP source file defines the StrLength class, a validation rule for string length constraints, including minimum and maximum bounds with optional inclusive or exclusive boundaries. It is part of a validation system within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: StrLength
classes.description: A validation rule class for checking the length of a string, with configurable min, max, encoding, and boundary inclusivity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the string length rule with optional min, max, encoding, and whether bounds are inclusive.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the input string length satisfies the min and max constraints.

methods.name: validateMin
methods.description: Checks if the length is above or equal to the minimum value, considering inclusivity.

methods.name: validateMax
methods.description: Checks if the length is below or equal to the maximum value, considering inclusivity.
